content:
The highly anticipated Emmy Awards kick off this weekend with the Creative Arts ceremony revealing its winners first. The primetime ceremony will take place on September 14, when top honours including Best Drama Series and Best Comedy Series will be handed out.

So far, Apple has every reason to celebrate — Apple TV+ swept a record-breaking 20 awards this weekend. The vast majority came from the comedy Widows Bay, which took home 8 wins and is viewed as the frontrunner for Best Comedy Series.

Apple currently leads the 2026 Emmys with 20 awards, followed by HBO Max with 16 and Netflix with 13. Once the primetime Emmys are fully handed out, the latter two are expected to overtake Apple in total wins, though Apple should still hold a respectable third place.

Apple is expected to shine in the comedy categories, but may be outshone in drama by competitors such as The Pitt. The answers will be revealed next Monday.

According to current tallies: Widows Bay took 8 awards, Pluribus 4, Margo's Got Money Troubles 3, Palm Royale 3, and the documentary Mr Scorsese 1.

Of these, 19 went to Apple TV+ originals; the remaining one was Apple's advertisement I'm Not Remarkable, bringing the total to exactly 20:

Widow's Bay

  • Best Guest Actress in a Comedy Series: Betty Gilpin
  • Best Art Direction for a Half-Hour Program
  • Best Casting for a Comedy Series
  • Best Cinematography for a Series (Half-Hour)
  • Best Original Music for a Series (Original Dramatic Score)
  • Best Music Supervision
  • Best Sound Editing for a Comedy or Drama Series (Half-Hour) or Animation
  • Best Sound Mixing for a Comedy or Drama Series (Half-Hour) or Animation

Pluribus

  • Best Art Direction for a Contemporary Dramatic Program (One Hour or More Per Episode)
  • Best Editing for a Drama Series
  • Best Original Main Title Theme Music
  • Best Sound Mixing for a Comedy or Drama Series (One Hour Per Episode)

Margo's Got Money Troubles

  • Best Contemporary Costume Design for a Series
  • Best Contemporary Hairstyling
  • Best Contemporary Makeup (Non-Prosthetic)

Palm Royale

  • Best Choreography for a Scripted Program
  • Best Costume Design for a Period or Fantasy/Sci-Fi Series
  • Best Makeup for a Period or Fantasy/Sci-Fi Series (Non-Prosthetic)

Mr. Scorsese

  • Best Documentary or Nonfiction Series

Apple TV+ entered this season with a record-breaking 89 Emmy nominations; how many translate into wins will become clear at the primetime ceremony on September 14. These figures once again reflect the industry's strong critical endorsement of Apple's programming overall.
